design.snapshotHint: Save an independent copy of the current system, including its context and configuration. Existing adaptations remain unchanged.

design.included: Included in Macro · Adapt to your project

design.otherChanged: Other parts of the document changed.
design.groupHint: Use the chat to group related responsibilities.
design.createSystemHelp: Start from scratch or use a blueprint.
design.fillAdaptationsHint: These details guide the agent when adapting the system to this project.
